description: Compare routes, then build the SIGNABLE artifact for the winner. Returns an unsigned transaction (LI.FI/ParaSwap/0x) or EIP-712 typed data for an off-chain order (CoW) -- the artifactKind field says which, and they require different wallet actions. Re-quotes before preparing and reports drift against the comparison. Never signs or broadcasts.

source.description: force a specific source instead of the winner (flagged in the result)

taker.description: the REAL wallet that will sign. Placeholder/burn addresses are rejected: quoting is anonymous, preparing is not.

name: prepare_best_route
